content.comment_body: After uploading the program, my [product_name] is not being monitored, even though the logic is developed in ladder. What should I do to resolve this issue?
Hello, please verify the communication. You can only monitor the block when it is properly connected to the PLC.
There should be an error message. Could you provide a screenshot of the error?
I've verified the communication, and if the upload is successful, the connection seems fine. However, I still can't monitor the uploaded data.
I'm attaching a screenshot. Both programs are the same; one is downloaded and the other is uploaded from the same PLC. The uploaded logic isn't being monitored, while the downloaded one is.
Hello, there appears to be a mismatch between online and offline blocks. Please compare the logic.

The error message indicates the programs on the [product_name] and PC are not identical, preventing online monitoring. It's common for ladder logic on the [product_name] to have issues. This error can also occur if parameters are changed on the [product_name] after uploading. Can you upload your program to the forum?

Hello, make sure to check which version of [product_name] is actually running the program. If there's a discrepancy, change the device type in LSC to match (use CTRL+H). There are several types of [product_name] 6—select the appropriate one and retry. Before starting monitoring, press F2 to review the status window for any errors. Avoid altering parameters on the device while monitoring. Hope this helps.
Has your issue been resolved? If so, what was the underlying cause?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties monitoring programs in [product_name] software after uploading logic to the device. While downloaded logic can be monitored, uploaded logic often cannot, likely due to differences between the program on the PC and the device after upload, or possibly changes made post-upload. Error messages are not sufficiently detailed, requiring users to compare software versions manually for troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliable, uninterrupted program monitoring after uploading logic to [product_name] devices, with no loss of synchrony or need for extra manual checks. They expect error messages to clearly explain the issue and suggest actionable solutions.
